name: Gitea
summary: Self-hosted Git service with issues, pull requests and packages, with the administrator created at install and registration disabled.
notes: Gitea 28.2.0 pinned by tag and digest, SQLite database, install wizard locked, public registration disabled. Repositories are cloned over HTTPS only; Gitea's built-in SSH server is disabled. Caddy provides HTTPS (Let's Encrypt with a domain, self-signed on the bare IP). The admin email is a placeholder that the owner can change in settings. The username admin is reserved by Gitea, so the account is gitadmin.

licence.note: Gitea MIT. Image bundles Alpine Linux base (various permissive/GPL packages), git (GPL-2.0), OpenSSH (BSD). Caddy Apache-2.0. Docker Engine Apache-2.0.
